summary_en: TOYODA GOSEI authorized acquisition of up to 36 million shares (6.1% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 3 billion yen through market purchase from October 30, 2026 to March 31, 2027. Approximately two-thirds of acquired shares will be canceled to enhance capital efficiency and shareholder returns toward ROE 10% target; one-third will be reserved for a new restricted stock (RS) program for employees.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Pertaining to Acquisition of Own Shares and Cancellation of Own Shares
translation_en_brief:
On October 29, 2026, TOYODA GOSEI's board of directors authorized the acquisition of its own shares to support two strategic objectives: enhancing capital efficiency and shareholder returns, and strengthening investment in employees. The company will acquire up to 36 million shares (6.1% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 3 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between October 30, 2026 and March 31, 2027.

Approximately two-thirds of the acquired shares, roughly 26 million shares, will be canceled to improve capital efficiency and strengthen shareholder distributions while supporting the company's 2030 business plan target of maintaining stable ROE of 10%. The cancellation is intended to accelerate EPS growth and enhance per-share value over the medium and long term by optimizing the balance between growth investment and shareholder returns.

The remaining one-third of acquired shares, approximately 10 million shares, will be reserved as the funding source for a new restricted stock (RS) program for employees starting in fiscal 2027. This program will provide continuous allocations over five years, with a maximum of 300 shares per employee annually. The company believes that enhancing employees' sense of participation in long-term corporate value creation and sharing the results with shareholders will serve as a key driver of sustained growth. The specific timing, allocation, and other details of the RS grants will be determined by the board of directors in each fiscal year, considering business performance, social conditions, and program outcomes.
